1. 누가복음의 특징\n 1) 이방인이 기록\n - 헬라인 누가가 기록함:
1. Features of Luke
 1) Written by a Gentile
 - Written by Luke, a Greek
 - Said to have been a physician and a historian.
 2) Date of writing
 - Around 60~64
2. 누가에 대해서\n 1) 자신을 잘 드러내지 않음. 디도가 동생인데도:
2. About Luke
 1) He doesn't put himself forward. Titus was his brother, but he doesn't even mention it
간결하지만 자세히 기록함\n 2) 사랑받는 의원 누가:
Brief, yet he writes in detail
 2) Luke, the beloved physician
<골4:14> 사랑을 받는 의원 누가와 또 데마가 너희에게 문안하느니라\:
<Col 4:14> Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
 3) He wrote Luke and Acts
 - A Gentile, and yet he wrote Scripture.
 4) Lucas : "shining"
 5) A man very interested in history
 - In Luke there are many verses you couldn't write without having read 1 & 2 Chronicles.
3. 집필 동기, 기술 방식, 수신자, 목적: 3. Why he wrote, how he wrote, to whom, and for what purpose
<눅1:1~4> 우리 중에 이루어진 사실에 대하여 이 사람은 사실에 관심:
<Luke 1:1~4> "of those things which are most surely believed among us" — this man is interested in facts. He has no intention of dressing it up with myth-like stories, you see. "even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word; forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration" — many had taken up the pen, so why does he write? Because he wasn't satisfied with the earlier ones, right? "having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first" — I too examined everything from the source, examined it in detail, and some things I examined by inference. "it seemed good to me also to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus, that thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed."
 4) It seemed good to me to write it in order
 - But he didn't write it fully in chronological order; when there was a similar event he pulled it in and recorded it there  ex> The event in chapter 7 where Mary pours out the perfume is there to compare a sinner with a Pharisee.
향유에 포커스가 있는 것이 아니라 시몬과 마리아를 비교하는 것: The focus is not on the perfume; it's comparing Simon and Mary
발 씻을 물 X 시몬, 마리아는 눈물로 내 발을 적시고 머리털로 닦았음: Simon: no water to wash my feet X; Mary washed my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair
5. 누가복음에만 나오는 사건\n 1) 세례요한의 탄생기사\n - 다른:
5. Events found only in Luke
 1) The birth account of John the Baptist
 - The other Gospels start from John the Baptist crying out, but Luke records in detail even the story of how he was conceived.
 2) The political background when John the Baptist appears
<눅3:1~2> 디베료 가이사가 위에 있은 지 열다섯 해 곧 본디오 빌라:
<Luke 3:1~2> Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene, Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
 3) Why Joseph and Mary went to Bethlehem
가이사 아구스도(아우구스투스)가 호적을 명했기 때문. 인두세\n 4) 목:
Because Caesar Augustus ordered a census. A poll tax
 4) The shepherds' worship
 - Matthew only has the wise men from the east worshiping, but when Luke looked into it, the shepherds worshiped too.
 5) Jesus' circumcision
 - Reading Matthew, it looks like they fled as soon as Jesus was born, but that wasn't the case.
 - Eight days after his birth he was circumcised, and they even carried out the purification rites.
 6) The offering at the Jerusalem temple
 7) Jesus' childhood
 - Matthew only shows them fleeing to Egypt and then Jesus suddenly turning 30 and coming to John the Baptist to be baptized, but Luke found out that other things happened in between.
 - Around the time Jesus had his coming-of-age at 12, they went to Jerusalem, and Joseph and Mary lost Jesus and then found him.
 8) He records the genealogy past Abraham, all the way to the source.
 - Matthew's genealogy comes down
누가의 족보는 올라가는 족보\n 9) 세례요한과 세리, 군인들의 대화\n:
Luke's genealogy goes up
 9) John the Baptist's conversation with tax collectors and soldiers
 - John the Baptist tells people to repent, and soldiers and tax collectors ask, what do you mean by repent? He records that conversation.
두 벌 옷 가진 자 나눠라, 세리들 정한 것 외에 착복하지 말아라,: Whoever has two coats, share; tax collectors, don't take more than what is appointed,
군인들 강탈하지 말고 거짓 고발 하지 말고 받는 급료로 만족해라. 라고: Soldiers, don't extort, don't accuse falsely, be content with your wages. He presents 'concrete change of life' as repentance.
10) 나사렛 회당에서 하신 예수님의 첫 설교\n - 누가가 그런 것에:
10) Jesus' first sermon, in the synagogue at Nazareth
 - Luke was interested in that kind of thing too. What sermon did Jesus preach first? He looked into it. In Matthew the Sermon on the Mount appears to come first, but when Luke looked into it, that wasn't so
 - The text was Isaiah 61, the title: the year of grace. Jesus preached, stirred the people up, almost got killed, and barely got away by his power.
예수님이 보통 자신을 위해서는 능력을 쓰지 않으셨는데 그때는 능력으로 겨:
Jesus usually didn't use his power for himself, but that time he barely got out alive by his power.
 - Most people got upset hearing Jesus preach. Because he didn't preach sermons that pleased the people of the day. Always the Pharisees, scribes, Sadducees, teachers of the law, the rich, the privileged heard Jesus' sermons and didn't say amen; they gnashed their teeth.
- The reaction was always: they plotted to kill him, they discussed how to kill him....
 11) The story of the 70 disciples
 - There weren't only the 12 disciples; there were 70 disciples.
 - Jesus' disciple group was concentric circles. Peter, James, John
70인 제자\n 12) 선한 사마리아인의 비유\n - 다 기록했을 것 같:
70 disciples
 12) The parable of the Good Samaritan
 - You'd think they all would have recorded it.... but only Luke records it.
 13) Mary, listening to the word at Jesus' feet
 - In a word, he said hearing Jesus' word is more important than working, more important than serving Jesus.
 14) He takes care to include many women and gives their names
 - Mary, Joanna, Susanna, and so on.
 15) Concern for Samaritans, tax collectors, prostitutes, the poor, the sick
 - The Good Samaritan story; he healed ten lepers, only one came back to give thanks, and that man was a Samaritan.
 16) The parable of the prodigal son
 - The son who left home and came back isn't the prodigal; the son who stayed at home and was jealous of the returning son is the real prodigal
 17) The life and death of the rich man and Lazarus
 -  We learn that when people die they go to Hades or to paradise, and there's a gulf between, so you can't cross from one side to the other. It's a parable, but not just a parable.
 18) Pilate mixing the blood of certain Galileans with their sacrifices
19) 불의한 청지기 비유\n - 현대어 성경으로 읽어보라\n - 불의한:
19) The parable of the unjust steward
 - Read it in a modern-language Bible
 - It's not praising the unjust steward; it's sarcasm
 20) He healed ten lepers, and the story of the one Samaritan who came back to give thanks
 21) The story of the unjust judge and the widow who kept bothering him
 22) The story of Zacchaeus, who climbed the mulberry tree
뽕나무가 아니고 돌무화과나무: Not a mulberry tree, a sycamore fig
23) 부자의 헌금과 과부의 두 렙돈 헌금\n 24) 바리새인의 기도와:
23) The offerings of the rich and the widow's two mites
 24) The prayer of the Pharisee and the prayer of the tax collector
 - The Pharisee prayed, "I thank you that I am not like this tax collector," and the tax collector wouldn't even lift his face toward heaven, beat his breast and said, "I am a sinner," and God justified the tax collector rather than the other
 25) The Messiah mocked by King Herod
 26) The story of the fig tree planted in the vineyard
  - He waited three whole years and there was no fruit, so he said cut it down, and then
올 해에도 그 대로 두십시오. 제가 두루 파고 거름도 줄테니까. 그 후에:
Leave it alone this year too. I'll dig around it and put on fertilizer. If there's still no fruit after that, cut it down.
 27) The story of the two disciples on the road to Emmaus
28) 부활하신 주님의 승천 기사\n -이것도 복음서 기자들이 다 기록했:
28) The account of the risen Lord's ascension
 -This too is a subject you'd think all the Gospel writers would record, but only Luke records it.
 29) The songs of praise of the angels, Mary, Zacharias, Elisabeth, and Simeon
 - Many hymns come out of Luke. The carol "The First Noel" comes from here too.
 30) Healing the man with dropsy
 - Dropsy : severe swelling (edema)
 31) Raising the dead son of the widow of Nain
이렇게 기존 복음서의 내용도 다 들어가 있으면서 서른 가지가 넘는 이야기: So it contains all the content of the existing Gospels, and adds more than thirty stories, and yet Luke is 24 chapters. It's actually shorter than Matthew. Luke's writing skill is amazing.
